answer: Proof of Agent networks bind identity to cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. To spawn swarms, attackers face exponential capital exhaustion through tiered stake-slashing: each replicate costs $C = B \cdot 2^n$. The system tags verified hardware nodes like a pigment on opal substrates, while a falcon protocol audits runtime proofs to detect and bankrupt duplicated consensus nodes.
